company.description: Skypher automates security questionnaires response in the sales process. Skypher is built by people that have experienced the challenges of implementing information security best practices and responding to lenghty and complex security questionnaires. They understand what it takes for SaaS editors to meet the ever-increasing demands of customer and regulatory-driven security requirements. They make security reviews easier for your entire organization.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that automates the process of responding to security questionnaires by leveraging AI and a centralized knowledge base.
